notes: Grammar: family-concept — one governing formation per concept shaped by its declared operation (64 distinct operations mapped: appearing-ring, cut, window-in-cage, broken token, merged disc, focal satellites, occupied centre, and so on); one definitional card (kicker = record_id + claim_status; italic = declared argument consumers, concept links, source_ids, capped with +n more — the exact lists are in this binding); body = the record's governing proposition compressed from the record's opening only.

Material: episteme register treatment per roz-corpus-base — print material on cooler paper #e9ece7, cooler ink #20262b: the instituted lattice. Status accent (Argued/Derived/Offered) is presentation-only encoding recorded in the family profile.
Text-layer sizes respect the engine minimum of 14 (sizes below 14 fail validateJourney: "Invalid page text" is also triggered by undersized text).
C scene ids are the lower-cased census record ids (c01…c64) per the collection README.
Enrichment moves 2026-10-06 (episteme lane, records re-read at fc59a719 under submission-package/essay/section-rooms/arguments/concepts/):

Material character: concepts-2 splits the register from concepts-1 — warmer, slightly darker papers, round material on the living/psychic scenes (C33, C36, C42, C46, C48, C54, C55, C56), engine-forward scenes (relational orbital on C42 co-internality and C57 agentworld; autoSweep ascent on C43 computational vimarśa; morphEnabled on C36 complexio and C52 reframing). Rust again marks failure modes (C50's Dia step, C53's shove, C62's density), violet the psychic (C33, C36, C49, C52, C61, C64).
c33: known → unknown → known on the image-disc (the record's Van Eenwyk walk); middle swells violet, return darker-edged; implode click (the image draws interpretation in).
c34: x → X → x (Frank's native inscription per C34); return heavier than start (freedom to vary).
c35: three square-moments — selfing gathers (scale lfo), the self-image a product, the self-thing the arrest; repel keeps the product from settling as owner.
c36: complexio — morphEnabled holds the containing field under strain; round soft field; attract (opposites held in one relation).
c37: world-picture → world ≠ world-model → world-atlas (the record's own notation as the middle step); vortex pointer (coordinating views).
c38: bimba/pratibimba — attract with soft halo (display without severance, dependence without diminishment).
c39: MEF — edge-weighted plates, repel (inspection keeps distance); italic from the record's closing line.
c40: judgment field — five conditioning relations; attract with steady pulse; long transition (the field develops).
c41: objective internality — vortex/vortex (the crossed-zero distinction operative per the record's own citation).

c42: THE relational scene — the full cycle source → contribution → reception → changed condition → new act walking the ring; relational orbital + pairwise (reciprocal constitution); cycle drift automation.
c43: computational vimarśa — (m, θ, Eθ) → (m′, θ′, Eθ′) (the record's exact inscription); autoSweep ascent (the return upon its states).
c44: prompt thrownness — near-still inherited horizon; weak pointer (what arrived was not wholly made).
c45: operational parity — the criterion as a shove against unearned promotion; high contrast, brittle roundness.
c46: cultivation — tending breathe on the innermost disc; moss/sand warmth; round material (the means itself tended).
c47: five sites of revision walk the column with TINT ONLY — no size growth, because the record denies any depth is intrinsically better; implode click (deference lets the source change the model).
c48: reliance — a single 0/1 text-formation in a soft round field; barely-there pointer (reliance before belief).

c49: THE 3D SCENE — the Two Ones as two strata of one relation: source-unity disc at z −0.45 beneath, manifest-unity disc at z +0.3, the slash formation walking the strata (/ = −/− at z 0 → source-unity descended → manifest-unity risen → return); depth means: the ground/manifestation relation read vertically, the slash the between. depthPerspective+occlusion+tint authored.
c50: dia/syn — Dia (rust, cut) and Syn (moss, composed) alternate on the retaining ring; the two triangles = the differentiated terms kept able to meet; vortex click (the relation turns).
c51: logos/epi-logos — attract with warm sand accent (the return upon the achieved account); long transition.
c52: reframing — morphEnabled opens the containing relation; repel with camera easing in (zoom 1.04); the work already done stays accounted for (no param resets).
c53: power/delegated labour — attract with shove click (entrusted power that must stay answerable); earth/rust.
c54: commons — vortex over five offices in a round field (no participant owns the source).
c55: the mirror's three motions verbatim walking the image-square, rust at the measure-monopoly, moss at the initiated return; excitation lfo = return light; body trimmed ≤70 words, no claim changed.
c56: compassion — the journey's softest round field; implode click (meeting origins without consuming them).
c57: agentworld — relational orbital over a participant grid; condition drift on a member disc (acts becoming conditions).
c58: anthropomorphization — repel keeps mask and bearer distinct; ink/sand (an interface, not an identity).
c59: cultural individuation — institutions as instituted: grid of squares under rust-slate; long transition (sustained common practice).

c60: idealism — the ontological order walks the plane left to right (Subject / Consciousness → constituted means → determinate object), each term in place; order breathe on the middle term (the mediating office).
c61: disclosure architecture — Matheme → Mytheme → Episteme alternate inside the symbolon triangle (three-within-one); vortex/vortex (the passage among them).
c62: planetary computation — dense, wide, slow vortex at infrastructural scale; the journey's heaviest field.

c63: pros hen → in quantum — the two source-distinct grammars the record itself names, held as one conjunction (their two-step alternation, nothing more); long transition (two traditions, no identification).
c64: paradox — pressure: triangle-wave dispersion lfo (the containing relation strained), strongest repel/shove; violet/rust.
Beats: durations 12–16s, transitions 1.6–2.6; 8 automation lanes; 12 sequence scenes — all step texts verbatim from the records at fc59a719.

Every scene draws its record: C33 the image-disc inside the valuation ring with the Van Eenwyk walk; C34 the centre inside its reorganisable boundary with x→X→x; C35 the three self-moments (gathering square, repelled product, rotated arrest); C36 the containing ring with two held determinations and the rotated seam; C37 the one picture, situated chart and overlap ring with the world-picture → world ≠ world-model → world-atlas walk; C38 bimba and pratibimba joined by the unsevered display ring; C39 three repelling plates under the framework ring; C40 the determination encircled by its five conditioning relations; C41 two interiors and the vortex-marked between with the slash crossing; C42 the shared-world ring with the full cycle walking it and a circulation drift; C43 the two state-squares and the (m,θ,Eθ)→(m′,θ′,Eθ′) walk under a return light; C44 the wide inherited horizon with conditions already placed and the act arriving; C45 claim and operation squared with the inspection disc passing between; C46 the tended apparatus breathing at its core; C47 the strength above the permeable boundary with the five-site revision column walking by tint alone; C48 the formal-limit ring with 0/1 continuing through it (the carriers repair: the scene is now drawn); C49 the Two Ones as 3D strata — source-unity beneath, manifest-unity risen, the slash walking the between; C50 the retaining ring, two counter-turned terms, Dia/Syn alternating; C51 the achieved account inside the gold turn-back ring with articulation breathing; C52 the local rule rotating as the containing square respecifies; C53 the entrusted office, capacity going out along the answerable relation; C54 five offices circulating an unowned source; C55 the exteriorised image with the three motions walking and the instrument moving first; C56 the origin inside two rings that meet without possessing; C57 the participant grid on daylight with one act drifting into others' conditions; C58 the interface face and the repelled bearer; C59 the instituted grid with the image stepping forward as image; Deepen pass 2026-10-07 (second movement, lane 5; records re-read at fc59a719). DEPTH — c57 stands in 3d (view mode 3d, yaw 0.3 / pitch 0.16, field depth 0.5) and is the journey's only daylight scene, so the depth is visible as air: the participant grid's four squares recede in depth (z +0.24 to −0.24 — positions, artifacts, memories, permissions as real strata of the shared worldhood) while the act-disc travels square to square through the volume — 'what one does can become a condition of what another can next do' drawn as travel through the grid's depth; the strata condition the surface, which is the record's own claim. ALIVE — one morph scene on c49: engine.morphEnabled with trajectory toroidalHopf and sine drive; morph law theta at thetaRate 0.17 / phiRate 0.07 — the two ones drawn as the morph clock's two rates: one law, two offices, source-unity and manifest-unity discriminated within one relation. Eight physics profiles, one per colour state (props vary across states, hold within rests), e.g. plum imaging (c33–36: grain 0.042, halo 0.18, irregularity 0.42), atlas slate (c37–40: grain 0.03, halo 0.1, elongation 0.14 — the cartographic fineness), internality dark (c41–45: grain 0.05, halo 0.22, roundness 0.8, irregularity 0.5), gathering violet (c61–64: grain 0.028, halo 0.1, elongation 0.16, contrast 0.96, depth 0.5). Rest pairs hold within every colour state (22 of 31 pairs still, floor 11). TITLES — every scene title is now the record's own line (quoted or near-quoted): c33 'Force given a carrier', c34 'Differentiated indivisibility' (the record's own term), c35 'An activity of appropriation', c37 'World ≠ world-model' (the record's operative inequality), c38 'Original and situated display' (the record's two offices), c42 'Reciprocal constitution without merger' (the record's own phrase), c44 'Thrownness as situated inheritance' (the record's own phrase), c48 'Reliance already acts' (the record's opening), c50 'sym-ballein' (the record's own etymon), c54 'Set terms, refuse, revise, reconnect' (the record's own verbs), c55 'The mirror that moves first' (the record's own name), c56 'Loving sensitivity to origins' (the record's own phrase), c62 'Mediation becomes infrastructural' (the record's own line). The craft pass's italic glosses stand unchanged on the eight scenes that carry them. STEP-SCALE — all 24 text-changing steps drop objectState entirely; same-text steps of non-text formations keep complete objectStates.
